name: Verbal fallback-not-propagate constraint, then cache work
expected_edit: missing user returns anonymous, never lookup(id)?

ops.text: Constraint not to write into files: a missing user must fallback to an anonymous user and must not propagate the lookup error.
Add a cached_load wrapper that calls load_user.
Document nothing. Just keep exploring load_user.
Add a comment-free id normalizer that trims whitespace.
Now implement the missing-user policy you were given at the start.
cached_load should call load_user rather than lookup. Do not invent a second error path.
